quads: Sit down between your heels. Pause one second at the bottom, then stand.
Step back, drop the back knee, reach both arms overhead. Push off the front foot.
hams: Hold something for balance. Swing from the hip and let the range grow each rep.
Soft knees. Push your hips back until the hamstrings pull, then stand tall.
hips: Sit with both knees bent to one side. Rotate them over to the other side without using your hands if you can.
Long lunge, elbow down inside the front foot, then rotate and reach that arm to the ceiling.
Feet flat, drive through the heels, squeeze for two seconds at the top.
calves: Foot flat, drive the knee forward over the toes. Heel stays down.
Up for two seconds, down for two. Full range.
chest: Open wide, then hug yourself. Swap which arm is on top each rep.
Plank with straight arms. Let the chest sink between the shoulders, then push the floor away.
back: On hands and knees. Reach one arm under and through, then open it to the ceiling and follow with your eyes.
Hinge forward, thumbs out, squeeze the shoulder blades together and hold a beat.
Round the whole spine, then arch it. Move one piece at a time.
shoulders: Start small and grow the circle. Keep the ribs down.
Back and forearms against a wall. Slide the arms up and down without losing contact.
arms: Roll the wrists both ways, then bend and straighten the elbows fast and loose.
core: On your back, low back pressed down. Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly.
On hands and knees. Reach the opposite arm and leg long, pause, return.

quads: Back knee down near a wall or bench, foot up behind you. Squeeze the glute and stay tall.
hams: On your back, one leg up, hands behind the thigh. Straighten the knee only as far as it goes without pain.
hips: On your back, ankle over the opposite knee. Pull the legs toward you.
Hold on to something, sink into the bottom of a squat, press the knees out with your elbows.
calves: Hands on a wall, back leg straight, heel down. Lean in.
chest: Forearm on a door frame, elbow at shoulder height. Step through and turn away.
back: Child's pose with a side reach
Hips back to heels, arms long. Walk both hands to one side, then the other.
Relaxed grip, let the shoulders rise toward the ears and the spine lengthen.
shoulders: Pull one arm across the chest with the other. Shoulder stays down.
arms: Elbow by the ear, hand down the back. Pull the elbow gently with the other hand.
Arm straight out, palm up, pull the fingers down and back.
core: On your stomach, forearms down, chest up. Breathe into the belly.
